# Harbor Bikes Warranty

Last updated: September 1, 2026. This warranty covers bikes bought new from Harbor Bikes.

## Coverage
- Frame: lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects for the original owner.
- Fork and rigid components (handlebars, stem, cranks): 5 years.
- Wheels, drivetrain, brakes and other components: 2 years.
- E-bike motor and battery: 2 years or 500 full charge cycles, whichever comes first.
- Paint and decals: 1 year.

## Not covered
- Normal wear items: tires, tubes, brake pads, chains, cables, grips and saddles.
- Damage from crashes, misuse or racing, or from assembly by anyone other than Harbor Bikes.
- Bikes used for rentals or commercial delivery work.

## Free tune-up
Every new bike includes one free Standard Tune-Up (normally $85) within 60 days of purchase.

## How to make a claim
1. Bring the bike and your receipt or order number to the shop, or email photos to help@harborbikes.example.
2. We inspect the bike within 3 business days.
3. Approved claims are repaired or replaced at no cost. If a frame model is no longer made, we offer the closest current model.

If you ship a bike to us for a warranty claim, we refund the $40 boxing fee and the shipping cost when the claim is approved.

## Care
Follow the care instructions in your owner's manual. Store e-bike batteries between 20% and 80% charge.
